_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Through the Pipes#000.src: You hear someone in the distance.

Through the Pipes#001.src: I'm so glad you found it! I don't know what I would do if I lost Soosu's gift and my bag!
Through the Pipes#001.dst: 太好了，你找到了！要是弄丢了 Soosu 的礼物和我的包，我真不知道该怎么办！

Through the Pipes#002.src: You are? Excellent! Let's see what you've created.
Through the Pipes#002.dst: 是吗？太好了！让我看看你做了什么。

Through the Pipes#004.src: Are you sure you want to leave the dock?

Through the Pipes#006.dst: 发电机嗡嗡地运转起来。

Through the Pipes#007.src: You pull the hook off of the grapple. It might be useful later.
Through the Pipes#007.dst: 你把钩子从抓钩上取了下来。之后也许用得上。

Through the Pipes#009.src: You must be on your raft to use this.
Through the Pipes#009.dst: 必须在木筏上才能使用。

Through the Pipes#010.src: Find a way to open that gate. I don't want to be on this raft for any longer!
Through the Pipes#010.dst: 想办法打开那道闸门。我一刻也不想再待在这木筏上了！

Through the Pipes#012.src: Huh, this isn't- really what I expected.
Through the Pipes#012.dst: 咦，这……跟我想的不太一样。

Through the Pipes#013.src: Are you sure you want to reset your raft?
Through the Pipes#013.dst: 确定要重置你的木筏吗？

Through the Pipes#014.src: Maybe there's something you could build to get across...
Through the Pipes#014.dst: 也许可以造点什么东西过去……

Through the Pipes#015.src: That looks like enough leaf litter. You should return to the generator to fuel it now.
Through the Pipes#015.dst: 落叶看起来够了。现在该回到发电机那里给它添燃料了。

Through the Pipes#017.src: Especially considering how rarely Soosu shows up in public, this festival might be my only opportunity this year...
Through the Pipes#017.dst: 尤其是 Soosu 很少公开露面，这个节日可能是我今年唯一的机会了……

Through the Pipes#018.src: You should let Fichu know you're done.
Through the Pipes#018.dst: 你应该告诉 Fichu 你已经完成了。

Through the Pipes#019.src: The board crumbles under your step. Maybe there's another way to the other side.
Through the Pipes#019.dst: 木板在你脚下碎裂。也许还有别的路能到对面。

Through the Pipes#020.src: Talk with the citizen in despair at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Through the Pipes#020.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 与那位绝望的市民交谈。

Through the Pipes#021.src: H-Hey, you! Have you seen a raccoon anywhere?
Through the Pipes#021.dst: 嘿、嘿，你！你有看到一只浣熊吗？
Through the Pipes#021.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#022.src: I spent all my free time making a gift for Soosu, and that devil snatched it from me! It would be a shame if I never got the chance to give it to her...
Through the Pipes#022.dst: 我花了所有空闲时间给 Soosu 做了一份礼物，结果那个小恶魔从我手里抢走了！要是我再也没机会把它送给她，那就太可惜了……
Through the Pipes#022.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#023.src: This might be a big ask, but- do you think you could help me?
Through the Pipes#023.dst: 这可能要求有点多，不过——你觉得你能帮我吗？
Through the Pipes#023.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#024.src: Y-You will? I knew there was still some good left in this world!
Through the Pipes#024.dst: 你、你愿意？我就知道这世上还有好人！
Through the Pipes#024.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#025.src: Right! Last time I saw that raccoon, it was running into an alleyway south of the town center. It can't have gone too far!
Through the Pipes#025.dst: 好！我最后一次看到那只浣熊，它正跑进镇中心南边的一条小巷。它应该跑不了太远！
Through the Pipes#025.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#026.src: I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#026.dst: 我也会继续找那个蠢东西。祝你好运！
Through the Pipes#026.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#027.src: ...I get it. If you change your mind, come and talk with me again.
Through the Pipes#027.dst: ……我明白了。如果你改变主意，再来找我谈谈。
Through the Pipes#027.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#028.src: Yes! A raccoon! You've seen them before- surely? They're rampant around here!
Through the Pipes#028.dst: 对！一只浣熊！你以前见过吧——肯定见过吧？这附近到处都是！
Through the Pipes#028.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#030.src: You know, those furry gray creatures with the weird striped tails?
Through the Pipes#030.dst: 你知道的，就是那种毛茸茸、灰色、尾巴有奇怪条纹的动物？
Through the Pipes#030.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#031.src: ...I hope you know what a raccoon is.
Through the Pipes#031.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#033.src: Oh- you're back! Are you able to help me now?
Through the Pipes#033.dst: 噢——你回来了！现在能帮我了吗？
Through the Pipes#033.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#035.src: I really think it would be better if we split up to search, don't you agree?
Through the Pipes#035.dst: 我真的觉得我们分头找会比较好，你同意吧？
Through the Pipes#035.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#036.src: If you forgot, you should try searching south of the town center. But you do you, I suppose...
Through the Pipes#036.dst: 如果你忘了，就去镇中心南边找找。不过随你便吧……
Through the Pipes#036.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#039.src: Enter the drainage hole at to continue the search.

Through the Pipes#040.src: Dive deeper into the sewer network.

Through the Pipes#041.dst: 探索防洪闸门的另一边。

Through the Pipes#042.src: Find a way to get across the flooded section of the sewer.
Through the Pipes#042.dst: 想办法穿过下水道被淹没的区段。

Through the Pipes#043.src: Huh, is there someone down there?

Through the Pipes#045.src: Continue chasing the raccoon through the sewers.
Through the Pipes#045.dst: 继续在下水道里追浣熊。

Through the Pipes#046.src: You aren't getting away from me now!
Through the Pipes#046.dst: 你这次别想从我手里逃掉！

Through the Pipes#047.src: Encounter a familiar face in the sewers.
Through the Pipes#047.dst: 在下水道里遇见一张熟悉的面孔。

Through the Pipes#048.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!
Through the Pipes#048.dst: 啊哈！这下抓到你了，小偷！

Through the Pipes#052.src: {u}! You're here! I was wondering where you went!
Through the Pipes#052.dst: {u}！你在这里！我还在想你跑哪去了！
Through the Pipes#052.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#053.src: I've been chasing that raccoon the whole time! What in the world have you been up to?
Through the Pipes#053.dst: 我一直在追那只浣熊！你到底都在干嘛？
Through the Pipes#053.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#054.src: Whatever. I'm struggling to keep up the chase at this rate. But fortunately, I have just the thing that'll help you!
Through the Pipes#054.dst: 算了。照这样下去我快追不上了。不过幸好，我正好有个能帮上你的东西！
Through the Pipes#054.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#056.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#056.dst: 坏掉了！照这样下去我要怎么追上那个小贼？
Through the Pipes#056.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#057.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#057.dst: ……也许这一切都是白费力气。你可以试着修修看吧，不过不值得。
Through the Pipes#057.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#058.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#058.dst: 我往那边走，看能不能抓到那个害虫。你往另一边走，我们很快会再碰头。
Through the Pipes#058.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#059.src: Encounter the stranger in the sewers.
Through the Pipes#059.dst: 在下水道里遇见那个陌生人。

Through the Pipes#060.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!
Through the Pipes#060.dst: 啊哈！这下抓到你了，小偷！

Through the Pipes#065.src: Who are you? What are you doing here?
Through the Pipes#065.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#066.src: Ah, exploring the sewers? That's fun! I've basically been to every corner of {p}'s sewers.
Through the Pipes#066.dst: 啊，在探索下水道？真有意思！{p} 的下水道我基本上每个角落都去过了。
Through the Pipes#066.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#067.src: Say, is there any chance you stumbled upon that raccoon earlier? That pest snatched something of value from me!
Through the Pipes#067.dst: 对了，你刚才有没有碰巧遇到那只浣熊？那个害虫从我这里抢走了很重要的东西！
Through the Pipes#067.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#068.src: I was making a gift for Sovereign Soosu, but then that fiend just ran off with it! Horrible, isn't it?
Through the Pipes#068.dst: 我在给 Soosu 统领做一份礼物，结果那个恶棍就这样叼着它跑了！太可恶了，对吧？
Through the Pipes#068.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#069.src: Especially with how soon the festival is... I wouldn't want to miss my only opportunity this year!
Through the Pipes#069.dst: 尤其庆典马上就要到了……我可不想错过今年唯一的机会！
Through the Pipes#069.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#070.src: I could really use your help, and hey I have just the tool you'll want for exploring the sewers!
Through the Pipes#070.dst: 我真的很需要你帮忙，而且嘿，我正好有个你探索下水道会想要的工具！
Through the Pipes#070.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#072.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#072.dst: 坏掉了！照这样下去我要怎么追上那个小贼？
Through the Pipes#072.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#073.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#073.dst: ……也许这一切都是白费力气。你可以试着修修看吧，不过不值得。
Through the Pipes#073.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#074.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. What's your name... {u}? You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#074.dst: 我往那边走，看能不能抓到那个害虫。你叫什么名字……{u}？你往另一边走，我们很快会再碰头。
Through the Pipes#074.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#075.src: Find a safe way past the flooded rail tunnels.
Through the Pipes#075.dst: 找一条安全的路穿过被淹没的铁轨隧道。

Through the Pipes#076.src: Whew! I didn't mean to let go-
Through the Pipes#076.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#078.src: Perfect, I know where we are, and there isn't much further that foolish raccoon can run. We could corner it!
Through the Pipes#078.dst: 太好了，我知道我们在哪，那只蠢浣熊也跑不了多远了。我们可以把它逼到死角！
Through the Pipes#078.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#079.src: Now, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#079.dst: 现在问题是，我完全不知道要怎么穿过下一个区域。如果我没记错，那里淹得很严重。
Through the Pipes#079.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#080.src: {u}! OH NO! I didn't mean to drop that on you
Through the Pipes#080.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#081.src: W-why were you standing there? Out of all places?
Through the Pipes#081.dst: 你、你为什么站在那里？那么多地方偏偏站那里？
Through the Pipes#081.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#082.src: ...Okay. You seem to be alright. Sorry, I didn't realize you were standing right there!
Through the Pipes#082.dst: ……好吧。你看起来没事。抱歉，我没发现你就站在那里！
Through the Pipes#082.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#083.src: Alright, at least we're regrouped now. Try not to stand under any more heavy objects, alright?
Through the Pipes#083.dst: 好，至少我们现在又会合了。尽量别再站在重物底下了，好吗？
Through the Pipes#083.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#084.src: Moving forward, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#084.dst: 接下来的问题是，我完全不知道要怎么穿过下一个区域。如果我没记错，那里淹得很严重。
Through the Pipes#084.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#085.src: You'll need to find some way for us to cross. Too many people have gotten the worst of diseases by wading through that water- eugh.
Through the Pipes#085.dst: 你得想个办法让我们过去。太多人蹚那片水之后染上了最严重的病——呃。
Through the Pipes#085.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#086.src: Right! Let me know when you figure something out. I'll scout around, never had an excuse to explore this area before!
Through the Pipes#086.dst: 好！你想到办法就告诉我。我去四处侦察一下，以前从来没理由来这一带探索！
Through the Pipes#086.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#087.src: Huh? What's all this stuff? Did someone forget their construction equipment?
Through the Pipes#087.dst: 嗯？这些是什么东西？是有人忘了收施工器材吗？
Through the Pipes#087.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#088.src: I guess the maintenance crews never bother to pack up their equipment. Maybe you can use this stuff for something.
Through the Pipes#088.dst: 我猜维修队从来懒得收拾他们的器材。也许你能拿这些东西派上什么用场。
Through the Pipes#088.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#089.src: Check back in with me when you're done!
Through the Pipes#089.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#090.src: Navigate through the end of the sewer network with Fichu.
Through the Pipes#090.dst: 与 Fichu 一起穿过下水道网络的尽头。

Through the Pipes#092.dst: 你准备好了我就准备好了！
Through the Pipes#092.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#093.src: I'd appreciate it if you added a seat for me.
Through the Pipes#093.dst: 要是你能帮我加个座位，我会很感激的。
Through the Pipes#093.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#097.src: Bet no one's been here for a while.
Through the Pipes#097.dst: 我打赌这里好久没人来过了。
Through the Pipes#097.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#098.src: Wonder where that raccoon is now...
Through the Pipes#098.dst: 不知道那只浣熊现在在哪……
Through the Pipes#098.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#099.src: Soosu needs to see that state of this place...
Through the Pipes#099.dst: Soosu 真该来看看这地方现在的样子……
Through the Pipes#099.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#101.src: What else do you think we'll find?
Through the Pipes#101.dst: 你觉得我们还会发现什么？
Through the Pipes#101.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#102.src: I've heard a few stories about this place. Mostly bad ones...
Through the Pipes#102.dst: 我听过一些关于这地方的故事。大多不是好事……
Through the Pipes#102.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#103.src: I hope that raccoon hasn't gone too far...
Through the Pipes#103.dst: 希望那只浣熊没跑太远……
Through the Pipes#103.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#106.src: This raft looks fragile, be careful!
Through the Pipes#106.dst: 这木筏看起来很脆弱，小心点！
Through the Pipes#106.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#111.src: You know what you're doing, right?
Through the Pipes#111.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#113.src: Ah! I almost fell out of my seat.
Through the Pipes#113.dst: 啊！我差点从座位上摔下去。
Through the Pipes#113.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#115.src: Are you even capable of not hitting something?
Through the Pipes#115.dst: 你到底有没有办法不撞到东西？
Through the Pipes#115.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#116.src: One more hit and I'm taking over!
Through the Pipes#116.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#117.src: I don't trust you sailing this thing!
Through the Pipes#117.dst: 我可不放心让你开这东西！
Through the Pipes#117.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#119.src: It can't possibly be that hard!
Through the Pipes#119.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#120.src: Make sure to be careful, okay?
Through the Pipes#120.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#121.src: No wonder everyone avoids this place...
Through the Pipes#121.dst: 难怪大家都避开这地方……
Through the Pipes#121.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#123.src: You know where you're going, right?
Through the Pipes#123.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#124.src: When I get that raccoon, oh man...
Through the Pipes#124.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#125.src: How long have I even spent chasing that fool...
Through the Pipes#125.dst: 我到底花了多久在追那个蠢东西……
Through the Pipes#125.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#127.src: Keep an eye out for dangers!
Through the Pipes#127.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#128.src: Make sure we're staying on track.
Through the Pipes#128.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#129.src: Maybe rats are better than raccoons after all.
Through the Pipes#129.dst: 说不定老鼠终究比浣熊好。
Through the Pipes#129.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#130.src: I regret getting on this raft.
Through the Pipes#130.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#134.src: I cannot wait to get off...
Through the Pipes#134.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#136.src: I really don't want to insult you, but-
Through the Pipes#136.dst: 我真的不想冒犯你，但是——
Through the Pipes#136.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#142.src: Ah! What will we do now?!
Through the Pipes#142.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#144.src: Hmm, is the raft broken? We haven't moved for a while.
Through the Pipes#144.dst: 嗯，木筏坏了吗？我们好一阵子没动了。
Through the Pipes#144.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#145.src: Are you... going to have us move?
Through the Pipes#145.dst: 你……打算让我们动起来吗？
Through the Pipes#145.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#148.src: I'm not sure why you think this place is interesting enough to stop at.
Through the Pipes#148.dst: 我不知道你为什么觉得这地方有趣到值得停下来。
Through the Pipes#148.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#152.src: The raccoon is probably long gone at this point, thanks to your delay.
Through the Pipes#152.dst: 都怪你拖拖拉拉，浣熊现在大概早就跑远了。
Through the Pipes#152.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#153.dst: 太好了，我们又动起来了。
Through the Pipes#153.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#155.src: How long were we waiting for?
Through the Pipes#155.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#156.src: Huh? What are you doing with that?!
Through the Pipes#156.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#157.src: You're going to sink us with that!
Through the Pipes#157.dst: 你会用那个把我们弄沉的！
Through the Pipes#157.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#159.src: IS THAT AN EXPLOSIVE?! ARE YOU MAD!
Through the Pipes#159.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#160.src: HELP US! WE'RE GOING TO DROWN!
Through the Pipes#160.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#161.src: OH NO! GET ME OFF OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#161.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#164.src: Why did you think this was a good idea?!
Through the Pipes#164.dst: 你怎么会觉得这是个好主意？！
Through the Pipes#164.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#165.src: I gotta get off this thing!
Through the Pipes#165.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#166.src: Hey- maybe we should've been a bit further away from that train?
Through the Pipes#166.dst: 嘿——也许我们该离那列火车远一点？
Through the Pipes#166.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#169.src: Agh! Sorry, just got scared by that.
Through the Pipes#169.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#170.src: AHHHHH! THIS WAS A HORRIBLE IDEA!
Through the Pipes#170.dst: 啊啊啊啊啊！这真是个糟透的主意！
Through the Pipes#170.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#171.src: OUT OF ALL ROUTES YOU TOOK, ONE OF THEM INCLUDED A TRAIN!
Through the Pipes#171.dst: 那么多条路线，你偏偏挑了一条有火车的！
Through the Pipes#171.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#173.src: Huh? AH! THERE'S A TRAIN! GET OUT OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#173.dst: 嗯？啊！有火车！快离开这里！
Through the Pipes#173.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#176.src: YOU REALLY THINK THIS FLIMSY RAFT IS GOING TO SURVIVE A TRAIN?!
Through the Pipes#176.dst: 你真以为这艘破木筏挡得住火车吗？！
Through the Pipes#176.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#177.src: YOU FOOL! We barely missed being hit!
Through the Pipes#177.dst: 你这个笨蛋！我们差一点就被撞了！
Through the Pipes#177.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#178.src: Oh my- we survived! YOU ARE AN IDIOT! DON'T DO THAT AGAIN!
Through the Pipes#178.dst: 天啊——我们活下来了！你是个白痴！再也别那样做了！
Through the Pipes#178.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#179.src: This looks like the halfway point!
Through the Pipes#179.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#180.src: You'll need to find a way to open that gate, since I don't see any other way past.
Through the Pipes#180.dst: 你得想办法打开那道闸门，因为我看不到其他过去的路。
Through the Pipes#180.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#181.src: If I'm remembering correctly, just past this gate should be our destination!
Through the Pipes#181.dst: 如果我没记错，过了这道闸门应该就是我们的目的地！
Through the Pipes#181.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#182.src: Phew, we survived. That was a bit rough, but at least we made it.
Through the Pipes#182.dst: 呼，我们活下来了。是有点惊险，不过至少我们到了。
Through the Pipes#182.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#183.src: However, I think I'll definitely be avoiding boats for now...
Through the Pipes#183.dst: 不过，我想我暂时绝对要离船远一点了……
Through the Pipes#183.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#184.src: We made it! You did a pretty good job navigating, I knew I could trust you!
Through the Pipes#184.dst: 我们到了！你开得相当不错，我就知道能信任你！
Through the Pipes#184.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#185.src: Alright, let's chase down that raccoon once and for all!
Through the Pipes#185.dst: 好，我们来把那只浣熊彻底逮住！
Through the Pipes#185.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#186.src: I hope my prediction is right, and there really is no further it can run from here.
Through the Pipes#186.dst: 希望我猜得没错，它从这里真的无路可逃了。
Through the Pipes#186.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#188.src: Huh?! LOOK! It's the raccoon, that's it!
Through the Pipes#188.dst: 嗯？！快看！是那只浣熊，就是它！
Through the Pipes#188.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#191.src: Ah ha! Now you're cornered, you little imp!
Through the Pipes#191.dst: 啊哈！这下你被逼到死角了，你这小鬼！
Through the Pipes#191.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#192.src: Before you do anything, we need a way to take the gift back!
Through the Pipes#192.dst: 在你动手之前，我们得想个办法把礼物拿回来！
Through the Pipes#192.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#194.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#194.dst: 你看！我们终于把礼物拿回来了！我就知道我们做得到。
Through the Pipes#194.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#195.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#195.dst: 希望经过这一切它还完好无损……
Through the Pipes#195.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#196.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#196.dst: 它没事！谢天谢地！不然我真不知道该怎么办……
Through the Pipes#196.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#197.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#197.dst: {u}，从一开始你就帮了大忙。你付出的一切我怎么谢都不够！
Through the Pipes#197.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#198.src: Without your help, I don't even know if I could have caught that raccoon on my own!
Through the Pipes#198.dst: 要是没有你帮忙，我都不知道自己能不能抓到那只浣熊！
Through the Pipes#198.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#199.src: As a reward, I have an extra gift just for you! Thank you again for your incredible help!
Through the Pipes#199.dst: 作为奖励，我这里还有一份专门给你的礼物！再次感谢你了不起的帮助！
Through the Pipes#199.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#200.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#200.dst: 你看！我们终于把礼物拿回来了！我就知道我们做得到。
Through the Pipes#200.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#201.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#201.dst: 希望经过这一切它还完好无损……
Through the Pipes#201.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#202.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#202.dst: 它没事！谢天谢地！不然我真不知道该怎么办……
Through the Pipes#202.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#203.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#203.dst: {u}，从一开始你就帮了大忙。你付出的一切我怎么谢都不够！
Through the Pipes#203.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#204.src: Not only did you safely get us through a flooded tunnel with that creation of yours, but you came more prepared than I could have expected!
Through the Pipes#204.dst: 你不只用你造的那个东西让我们安全穿过了被淹没的隧道，准备得还比我预想的周全！
Through the Pipes#204.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#205.src: A cage... a ring to use as a distraction... and even a firecracker. Where did you even find all this stuff?
Through the Pipes#205.dst: 一个笼子……一枚拿来分散注意力的戒指……甚至还有一个鞭炮。你到底从哪里弄来这些东西的？
Through the Pipes#205.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#206.src: And on top of all of that, you found my art supplies bag! That bag itself is more important to me than the gift we were chasing after!
Through the Pipes#206.dst: 而且最重要的是，你找到了我的画具包！那个包对我来说比我们追回来的礼物还重要！
Through the Pipes#206.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#207.src: Speaking of that, I would like to give you Soosu's gift as a token of appreciation. I believe you're more deserving of it.
Through the Pipes#207.dst: 说到这个，我想把 Soosu 的礼物送给你当作谢礼。我觉得你比她更配得上。
Through the Pipes#207.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#208.src: Don't worry, I've already brainstormed a better design. I think Soosu will like this next one even more!
Through the Pipes#208.dst: 别担心，我已经想好更好的设计了。我觉得 Soosu 会更喜欢下一份！
Through the Pipes#208.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#209.src: Don't go so close! You might scare it off again!
Through the Pipes#209.dst: 别靠那么近！你可能又会把它吓跑！
Through the Pipes#209.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#210.src: Thank you again for the help! I couldn't have done it without you.
Through the Pipes#210.dst: 再次谢谢你的帮忙！没有你我办不到。
Through the Pipes#210.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#001~1.src: You're a lifesaver, {u}. I cannot thank you enough!
Through the Pipes#001~1.dst: 你真是我的救星，{u}。我怎么谢你都不够！

Through the Pipes#002~1.src: WAIT! MY ART BAG IS MISSING! Did I accidentally drop it somewhere?
Through the Pipes#002~1.dst: 等等！我的画具包不见了！难道是我不小心掉在哪里了？

Through the Pipes#003~1.src: Do you want us to sink?!
Through the Pipes#003~1.dst: 你是想让我们沉下去吗？！

similar.text: So you want us to sneak in?

Through the Pipes#004~1.src: What's your name... {u}? Great, I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#004~1.dst: 你叫什么名字……{u}？很好，我也会继续找那个蠢东西。祝你好运！

Through the Pipes#006~1.src: Maybe it's best to continue forward...

Through the Pipes#173~1.src: I gotta get off of this thing!
Through the Pipes#173~1.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#174~1.src: That's the exit! Go past this gate, then I never want to board anything sailed by you again!
Through the Pipes#174~1.dst: 那是出口！过了这道闸门，我再也不要坐任何你开的东西了！

Through the Pipes#207~1.src: {u}, from the very start, you have been a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#207~1.dst: {u}，从一开始你就帮了大忙。你的付出，我怎么谢都不够！
Through the Pipes#207~1.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#208~1.src: ...You don't think that was a little too brutal, do you?
Through the Pipes#208~1.dst: ……你不觉得刚才那样有点太粗暴了吧？
